    "d5e9397a: ;Lock the record",
    "e214345a: ;Set values for dictator, transcriptionist and signer/reviewer fields",
    "b69017fc: ;Execute the field updates and call STAT1 to update the status field",

    "3733bbe6: ;Exit the routine",
    "3f8e1d4f: ;\n ;Update the status based on the values of the nodes in the \"DT\" field.\n ;",
